name: Brother
source:
You lost your dear little sister, the only person in this world you cared about. 
Now you must bring her back.

[From [url=https://soulofkazak.itch.io/brother]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你失去了亲爱的妹妹，那个世界上唯一让你在乎的人。
现在，你必须把她带回来。

[摘自[url=https://soulofkazak.itch.io/brother]itch.io[/url]]
